title: AlleviaProvisionalSensorReadingsSchema
description: PROVISIONAL SIMULATOR CONTRACT - Maps directly to physical Detector Box sensor channels.

temperature_c.description: Ambient temperature from BME280 sensor in Celsius.

humidity_pct.description: Relative humidity from BME280 sensor percentage.

pressure_hpa.description: Atmospheric pressure from BME280 sensor in hectopascals.

mq2_adc.description: 10-bit raw ADC reading from MQ2 gas/smoke sensor (Pin A0).

mq7_adc.description: 10-bit raw ADC reading from MQ7 CO sensor (Pin A1).

mq135_adc.description: 10-bit raw ADC reading from MQ135 air quality sensor (Pin A2).

ir_triggered.description: Digital state from optical obstacle / beam break sensor (Pin D2). 0=Clear, 1=Triggered.

battery_voltage_v.description: System rail voltage reading (Nominal 5.0V / USB regulated).
